def f(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    # find nonzero 2x2 block
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=0]
    assert len(cells)==4
    rows=sorted(set(i for i,_,_ in cells)); cols=sorted(set(j for _,j,_ in cells))
    B=[[inp[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]
    out=[]
    for i in range(2*H):
        row=[]
        for j in range(2*W):
            row.append(B[min(i,j)][abs(i-j)%2])
        out.append(row)
    return out

def f(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=0]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j in cells))
    B=[[inp[i][j] for j in cs] for i in rs]
    n=len(B)
    return [[B[min(i,j)%n][min(i,j)%n] for j in range(2*W)] for i in range(2*H)]
print(f(I1)==O1, f(I2)==O2)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); OH=len(O); OW=len(O[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j in cells))
    B=[[I[i][j] for j in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)] for i in range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1)]
    print(k,'in',(H,W),'block shape',(len(B),len(B[0])),'out',(OH,OW))
    # diag of O along min axis: U[d]=O[d][d]
    U=[O[d][d] for d in range(min(OH,OW))]
    D=[B[i][i] for i in range(len(B))]
    print(' D:',D)
    print(' U:',U)
    n=len(D)
    ok=[k2 for k2 in range(n) if all(U[d]==D[(d+k2)%n] for d in range(len(U)))]
    print(' pure rotation of diag:',ok)

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    n=min(H,W)
    # find block: bounding box of nonzero
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j in cells))
    br0,br1,bc0,bc1=rs[0],rs[-1],cs[0],cs[-1]
    hz=br1-br0+1; wzs=bcs=bc1-bc0+1
    A=[[I[r+br0][c+bc0] for c in range(wzs)] for r in range(hz)]
    # choose ring indexing: min or max, whichever makes rings uniform in A
    def rings(fn,nm):
        C={}
        for k in range(min(hz,wzs)):
            vals=set(A[i][j] for i,j in [(k,k)] )
            if fn=='min': vals|=set(A[k+j][j] for j in range(k,hz)) | set(A[j][k] for j in range(k,wzs))
            else: vals|=set(A[j][k] for j in range(k,wzs))|set(A[k+j][k] for j in range(k,wzs))
            if len(vals)>1: return None

import json
def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j in cells))
    br0,br1,bc0,bc1=rs[0],rs[-1],cs[0],cs[-1]
    L=min(br1-br0+1,bc1-bc0+1)
    U=[I[br0+d][bc0+d] for d in range(L)]
    return [[U[max(i,j)%L] for j in range(2*W)] for i in range(2*H)]

    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=0]
